# procurement-market-intelligence
End-to-end procurement analytics pipeline - spend analysis, price, benchmarking, supplier risk scoring, and Power BI dashboard

# Procurement Market Intelligence — Deep Spend Analysis

End-to-end procurement analytics project built to demonstrate 
real-world skills for corporate procurement analytics roles.

## What this project covers
- SAP-structured spend database (EKKO, EKPO, LFA1, MARA)
- Multi-dimensional spend cube analysis
- Kraljic Matrix category positioning
- Supplier segmentation
- Tail spend analysis
- Price benchmarking against live commodity APIs
- Automated weekly market intelligence briefing (PDF)
- Power BI dashboard — Spend, Risk, Benchmarks

## Tech stack
- Python 3.13
- SQLite (SAP-structured)
- pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scikit-learn, reportlab
- Power BI Desktop
- FRED API, Bank of Canada API
- GitHub Actions (scheduled automation)
